title: Monocrystalline Solar Panel, Portable 200w Power Solution for Camping, Travel, and Outdoor Backup, 149 x 66.5 cm
description: Harness the power of the sun with this robust 200W Monocrystalline Solar Panel, designed to deliver reliable and efficient energy for a wide range of applications. Whether you are camping in the wilderness, travelling on the road, or need a dependable outdoor backup power source, this solar panel is built to meet your needs. The monocrystalline cells ensure high energy conversion efficiency, making the most of available sunlight even in partially cloudy conditions. Measuring 149 x 66.5 cm with a slim profile of just 3 cm depth, this panel is sizeable yet manageable for installation on rooftops, caravans, boats, or portable setups. The sturdy aluminium frame provides excellent durability and resistance to harsh weather conditions. Equipped with MC4 connectors and a junction box on the rear, it is straightforward to integrate into your existing solar setup. Ideal for off-grid living, emergency power backup, and outdoor adventures, this 200W solar panel is a practical and powerful addition to any energy solution. Please refer to the product dimensions and specifications carefully before installation.
